title: P256 redundant fused arithmetic and absolute differences

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P-256 target, the complete cold stored-leaf algorithm in proof.md recovers the scalar with probability at least0.39 under the stated ideal-coin scalar-instruction machine. At q1=188730254,q2=2^27 and2^72 nodes, the exact total is111905090986539276610513689812999210008576 instructions, below2^126.395543277191 units at C=1000. All cold construction, sampling and failed caps, representation-filter loss, both transport hops and finishing deliveries, grouping, resolution, verification and output are included. Forward, backward and emission bounds are132n+11,665n+9 and33n+12; inverse remains conservatively charged39479. The unconditional representation-filter collision loss is bounded byGamma*2^227/r^2 and is included in the exact success lower bound above0.3900000022346073. Memory below2^136 bytes, preprocessing below2^118 units included in total, no auxiliary powers and no nonuniform advice. This is an analytical bound with finite implementation checks, not production execution or formal certification.

experiments.purpose: Run independent field and pair checks, full batch inversion, metadata and capacity controls, small complete two-hop routing, actual toy scalar recovery, and exact probability/cold-work/layout consequences. Test scope is distinguished from the production proof.
